fusions.name: Splitting the Rot
fusions.desc: A falling chop that deals 16 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one, then leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Flying Chips
fusions.desc: Hacks a spray of coral splinters 3 tiles ahead of you that deals 4 damage to everything in the cone, with a 25% chance to leave each target [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Pruned Clean
fusions.desc: Cuts the festering coral out of your own wounds, removing up to 2 conditions from you and restoring 10 health.

fusions.name: Where It Festers
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
